name: Doughby
detailed_description:
Meet Doughby, a determined donut with a hole lot of heart! Explore the enchantingly odd land of Torlo, a wordless puzzle adventure where you'll arrange curious objects to solve observational riddles and bring smiles to its quirky inhabitants.

Forget instruction manuals! You'll need your keenest observational skills (and those surprisingly sturdy donut arms) to carry, plop, stack, and activate a bizarre menagerie of objects. Decipher visual clues, untangle peculiar predicaments, and aid the charmingly eccentric denizens of this world. Each screen is a playful puzzle waiting to be nudged, poked, and ultimately solved by your unique brand of donut ingenuity. Can you collect the curios and become the most esteemed donut in the cosmos?

short_description: Doughby, a little donut with big dreams is on a mission for his confectionery kin: to gather the rarest, strangest, most sought-after objects from across the whimsical world of Torlo.
